cohort: The study included 96,056 women from the Japan Environment and Children's Study (JECS).
finding: Women experiencing severe nausea and vomiting during pregnancy had lower odds for preterm birth, especially very preterm and extremely preterm births, compared to those who did not.
gest_age: NVP evaluated prior to 12 gestational weeks; outcomes defined by gestational age at birth (preterm, very preterm, extremely preterm birth).
